responses.text: Thank goodness you're here. My squad needs help.
You're the courier I've heard so much about. My squad needs your assistance.
So any word on my friends?
I'm glad to see a fellow trooper. My squad is in trouble.
Need something?
The Legion are trouble. You should watch out.
The road is dangerous. You better stay sharp.
My squad was ambushed by a Legion party lead by that bastard Alexus.
He was taking us into the mine up ahead, but I managed to get away. I need help to get them out.

topics.prompt: Why are you out here alone?

responses.text: If you want to be that way I'll leave you alone.
That's already more than I was expecting. I'll keep watch to make sure no more Legion come up the road. Good Luck.

topics.prompt: I'll take a look and see if there's anything I can do.

responses.text: There's a slim chance. But if the Legion wanted us dead, our heads would already be on pikes.
[SUCCEEDED] I understand. Here's what I have on me. Now go before it's too late.
[FAILED] This is an emergency. How can you be asking for payment?

topics.prompt: Extra encouragement would also increase their chances.

responses.text: There's no way I can take on the Legion by myself. I'll be here if you change your mind.

topics.prompt: The odds are too small. You're on your own.

responses.text: Really? I can't thank you enough. I'll wait here and watch the road. Good luck in there.

topics.prompt: I changed my mind. I'll save your squad.

responses.text: They must have run straight back to camp. I bet they didn't even stop and say thanks.
The NCR could use someone like you. Stop by our camps if you're looking for work.
Can you hurry? I know those Legion bastards are tough but my friends won't last long with all the radiation in there.
Were? What do you mean were?

topics.prompt: Were they the NCR hostages in the mine?

responses.text: Legion bastards. They'll pay for that.
I was worried Alexus had already thrown them down a mineshaft. I'll run by camp and see how they're doing when I get a chance. Thanks for the help.
